title: The Flute of Love [Starr. Chioma Chukwuka & Daniel K Daniel]
description: When the gods decree, who are we, mere mortals; to question the will of the gods. The movie flute of love possesses an unusual kind of epic story; a type done with rich vusuals, impassioned functionality aimed for a deeper impact on the targeted audience.In the movie, three great men have been nominated by the gods to perform the most challenging and unbelievable task which qualifies each of them to be selected as the royal groom for the beautiful amiable princess of the bride. As challenging and tough as their task appears, one man must eventually conquer against all odds. This masterpiece is indeed an overwhelming tale of surprise, discovery and reawakening. The gods do not make make errors and all destinies fall into their divine plan.

title: Rookie Historian Goo Hae-Ryung

title: A Questionable Protagonist
description: The city of Los Angeles is heavily divided into two zones: rich and poor. Crime is at its peak in the poor zone. Ex-NAVY SEAL Kyle H. Holmes is a washed up drunk living in the rich zone, he was the face of the African war campaign. After stumbling into the poor zone Kyle soon finds himself killing all those who cause crime in the poor zone, this becomes Kyle's new source for adrenalin and purpose, with Kyle killing, gang members, rapists and drug dealers, he of course makes enemies, including the corrupt cops and the notorious drug and crime lord, cocaine n' coco pops.

title: D.P. S1-S2
description: A young private's assignment to capture army deserters reveals the painful reality endured by each enlistee during his compulsory call of duty.

title: Big Daddy
description: A visitor to the Everglades swamps in Florida encounters and falls in love with an uneducated girl. But he finds competition for her affections from the unlikely and mysterious A. Beauregard Lincoln. He also discovers danger from nature in the form of vicious alligators and from the mystical in the form of a voodoo witch doctor.

title: Her Private Life
description: Follows a talented gallery curator named Sung Duk Mi, who is an idol fan-girl underneath her professional veneer. Meanwhile, her boss Ryan becomes a passionate fan-boy of her.

title: Saptrang
description: Avinash, a businessman and poet, plans a trip to find the girl of his dreams where he meets a painter and a musician. His life takes a turn when he learns how to live life from nature.

title: Happily N'ever After 2: Snow White: Another Bite at the Apple
description: Fairy tales collide when Mambo and Munk tip the scales of good and evil once again. This time Princess Snow White is a misguided teenager who'd rather have fun with friends Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks and Little Bo Peep than help peasants. When Snow White's father is matched up with Lady Vain - a scheming witch brewing to rule the kingdom - Snow White becomes a thorn in Lady Vain's side. Snow White is soon tricked by Lady Vain (with Rumpelstiltskin's help) into spreading vicious gossip about the townspeople, forcing her to flee. Through rebuilding the three little pigs' houses with the seven dwarves leading the way, Snow White learns the value of helping others. Only Snow White can foil her dad's wedding to stop Lady Vain. With Mambo and Munk in tow, Snow White proves she can rule the kingdom, while bringing balance back to the scales of good and evil.

title: Pudhu Pudhu Arthangal
description: A singer (Bharathi) who is tricked into marriage by his mother-in-law, his wife (Gowri )is enormously possessive about his fame and his female fans. One day they encounter into a fight and he decides escape from home. On the way he meets someone in the bus who is also running from her life as a dancer because her husband forcefully lets her to prostitution. They both experience some random incidents together and meet an one old couple, who are still very much enjoying love and life. Eventually the old couple dies, and by watching the couple they fall in love themselves. Then Bharathi get a prank call from his PA that Gowri is ill so he returns back to home town with Jyothi. Gowri finds him with another woman and gets furious. She files for a divorce, informs media about Jyothi. Jyothi's husband gets this news comes to find Jyothi. One thing led to another Gowri finally become mentally unstable because of her own decisions. Bharathi visits her in the mental hospital with Jyothi. Jyothi then understands that Gowri really needs Bharathi and they belong to each other, Jyothi leaves Bharathi with her. Jyothi's husband becomes a cripple and understands his mistakes, reunites with jyothi in the end.

description: Fate of a short film crew vs burglar crew who just robbed a bank.

title: The Best Hit

title: Alibhabha
description: The city is being shaken by many heart-stopping crimes taking place at different places. Young women are being molested and killed with alarming frequency. Velu (Kreshna) helps his father Subramaniam (Prakash Raj) in stealing. Being seasoned thieves, they rob everything right from pins to cars. A spate of young women are murdered, and these developments rock the city. Thiagarajan (Azhagam Perumal), a tough cop, investigates the case. However, differences of opinions crop between the Police Commissioner (Biju Menon) and Thiagarajan. One day, Velu saves the commissioner from a meeting in order to steal the commissioner car's audio player, and gets acquainted with him. Velu then begins to fall for Janani (Janani), who works in a bank. One day, when Velu withdraws money, he is shocked to find the balance amount to be Rs. 5 Lakhs. It suddenly swells to Rs. 30 Lakhs and reaches Rs. 70 Lakhs. That is when Subramaniam realizes that this is no mere coincidence. Someone was smartly using them as a pawn to cover up for other more serious activities. They were being used as the 'third man', a pretty common term in criminal parlance. Before they realize, all of them are caught in the web that was laid out. Who laid it out, how and why and do they eventually come out of it forms Alibaba. Subramaniam comes to Velu's rescue and manages to find the reason behind it. When the family begins to find out the reason behind this act, it results in bloodshed and gore, eventually ending up in Velu coming across the killers of young women in the city.

title: True Beauty
description: After being bullied and discriminated because of her ugly looks, a high school girl transforms herself into a gorgeous "goddess" and quickly rises to fame after mastering the art of makeup via online tutorial videos.

title: Delhi Riots... A tale of burn & blame
description: "Riots erupted in the northeast district of Delhi in February 2020. There were claims and counterclaims as to what triggered these riots and who all were to be blamed for it," he said. "But in this din the pain, suffering and loss of those who lost their kith and kin in these riots got ignored. This film is an attempt to capture this pain and suffering as well as an attempt to probe the root cause of these riots."

title: Too Young To Love
description: Gifted cellist Yi Lan, inspired by her mother’s influence and her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, forms a trio in her first week of high school to challenge the school orchestra and perform at the annual festival. Her fiery passion for music reignites Tong Xiaole’s own dream, and as they chase their ambitions together, love, friendship, and youth blend into a heartfelt symphony of growth and hope.

title: A Barefoot Dream
description: After a series of pipe dream ventures go belly up, retired pro soccer player Kim Won-kang happens to visit East Timor, where he finds children playing the game barefoot on rocky pitches. Sensing a new business opportunity on finding the country doesn't have a single sporting goods store, he embarks on a scheme to get rich quick by purveying athletic shoes to the unshod youngsters. Sadly, no one there can afford to pay $60 for a pair of shoes, even on a generous installment plan, and before he knows it, he is reduced to coaching a team of ragged 10-year-olds and prospects are looking grim.

title: R.E.M. Live
description: R.E.M. Live is a live album from R.E.M., recorded at the Point Theatre, Dublin, on February 26 and 27, 2005, the closing nights of the winter European leg of the Around the World Tour in support of their thirteenth studio album Around the Sun released in late 2004. It was released in the United Kingdom on October 15, 2007 and in the United States a day later as a two-Compact Disc audio set and a DVD, then released in February 2008 as a triple vinyl set. The performance was filmed by Blue Leach the same director of Depeche Mode DVD "Touring the Angel: Live in Milan". R.E.M. Live features rare performances of "I Took Your Name" from 1994's Monster and "Ascent of Man" from Around The Sun as well as the previously unreleased "I'm Gonna DJ." A studio version of that song would later appear on the band's 2008 effort, Accelerate.

description: Another story of a big family whose life is full of problems and unexpected changes. Barbara and Lucjan are about 60-years-old. They have three daughters and one son. title: Class N Session
description: Casting "Class N Session," a new series. Synopsis: Meet Kaitlyn Johnson (Jassy Marie), an intelligent, teenage African American sophomore girl with a quick sarcastic wit to match, which fits her future aspiration of becoming a criminal lawyer, which stems from watching marathon episodes of "Law and Order" on cable with her mother. Kaitlyn's best friend since pre-K is Vanessa Hardison (Alexis Dees), who's also an intelligent African American sophomore girl who decided her own future aspiration of becoming a celebrity lawyer after watching old footage of Johnny Cochran's performance in the O. J. Simpson trial. She also has a similar sarcastic quick wit. For years, these girls used the same facial expression to communicate with each other when someone said something idiotic. Their favorite facial expression is named "The Garfield Look," which matches the bored facial expression of Garfield the Cat. Both young ladies attend Ladera Heights High School, along with their new friends, Lisa Kim (their eccentric but very smart friend), Caleb Stevens and Louis Taylor (two of the brightest class clowns you ever want to meet; think Romeo and Bullethead from "The Steve Harvey Show," with intelligence), and Cissy Bailey (their sassy Caucasian friend who was raised in the hood). This prestigious secondary school is run by Principal Bryant, a very thorough, no-nonsense principal who's fair but firm and also has an annoying tendency to pop up unannounced on her students anywhere. Principal Bryant doesn't tolerate disruptive students who waste their time in high school; she's especially strict on rules about the students not sassing their parents. Every high school student has a favorite teacher; Mr. Reevis is that favorite teacher, who uses wit to teach his U.S. Government class. With Kaitlyn and Vanessa's aspirations of becoming a criminal lawyer and celebrity lawyer, can they survive through all the trials and tribulations high school has in store for them? Watch "Class N Session" to find out.

title: Rock 'n Tokyo
description: Tokyo proposes several different levels of reality. You can find anything you can imagine there and at the same time get a new surprise at every corner. I chose to portray this amazing city through rock 'n roll music. The Japanese love and understand rock, a kind of music and a way of life they discovered during the American occupation, after World War II. Even if Japanese society still preaches uniformity and order, there is an important underground world, where people live more freely. This is the Tokyo I show in my movie. We follow 4 rock bands : Guitar Wolf, 3 good looking guys wearing black leather and sunglasses, a singer/guitar player with a devilish presence, a garage rock that is among the most intense and loudest ever heard and surprisingly- a contract with a big record company ; The 5678s, rock-a-billy queens with a wild 50s elegance who conquered the world with a memorable scene in Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill ; the Jet Boys, led by an extreme, crazy, border-less and exhibitionist singer/guitar player ; Nine, young guys who believe in success by music - when I first met them, they played in front of Shinjuku station as if it was the last concert of their lives. The movie shows their music, but also their way of living, their style-totally faithful to rock ,n roll- and their wanderings all around the incredible city that is Tokyo.

description: 2002: Jake Mitchell is the defending World West Coast Swing Champion. He's got everything going for him: looks, personality, and style. He's at the top of his game when he and his partner Corinne are crowned the unexpected winners at the World Swing Dance Championships. As the crowd cheers and the celebration begins, Jake appears uneasy. Did he really deserve to win? The music blasts and the bass is thumping, and Jake hears none of it. He feels it. Jake is completely deaf, due to an ear infection when he was a teenager. He learned how to dance by feeling the vibrations of the music. Now he feels something else: that perhaps the judges gave him the win out of sympathy. Present Day: Jessica Donovan's life is boring. When she was younger, she was a dancer who had dreams of Broadway. Now she's an English teacher for disinterested, upper class middle school kids, and she's dying to let loose. Her fiancee Kent is a work-a-holic who cares more about making money than making Jessica happy. Jake's moved on with his life and he's now a dance teacher who travels around the country doing motivational speaking to students about how his disability did not hold him back. It's at a school assembly where Jake and Jessica first meet. He's up on stage telling kids that you have to believe in yourself. The spoiled rich kids show no interest at first, but Jake's charm and sense of humor gets them to laugh. Then his former partner Corinne joins him onstage and they dance. The crowd goes nuts! Jake meets Jessica and there's an instant connection; there's only one problem. Jake's still in love with Corinne and perhaps always will be. And Corinne knows exactly how to get under Jake's skin. Though she has a fiancee, she drives Jake nuts with her flirtatious ways. Jessica initially asks Jake to train both her and her fiancee in West Coast Swing for their wedding, but Jake and Jessica are drawn closer when Kent's non-stop job prevents him from going to the class. Jessica decides to take lessons from Jake... perhaps they can compete at the World Championships of Swing in the Pro-Am division? And they get better and better. They decide, at a dance party, to go for it all. Forget the Pro-Am; they want to try for the title that Jake felt he never deserved. But now the champions are all 18 year olds who can defy gravity, and Jake's in his early thirties. description: 1957. A happy time of big fins, Rockabilly music and innocent teen love... Until the Martians come. title: O Grito
description: After learning of her sister's death, Sofia comes back to Portugal to determine what led her to suicide.

title: O Carteiro
description: Victor (Candé Faria) is a postman in the interior of Rio Grande do Sul and has the habit of opening the correspondence of the residents. In love with a new resident of the city, the young Marli (Ana Carolina Machado), who exchanges letters with her boyfriend, Victor begins to control the letters between the couple and ends up interfering in the couple's relationship.

title: O'
description: O 'is a soap opera telling the adventures of a family of millionaires, the O'Hara, who own a bottled water company.

title: O Liberdade
description: The documentary talk about a magic place, the heart of the bohemian in Pelotas, southern Brazil. The Samba, Choro, and all the popular culture.

title: O Vigilante
description: It is the story of those who think that the best days are always ahead, after the rainbow or beyond the horizon line. When they can, they are leaving or thinking about leaving behind misery and hunger, but most of the time they just leave the hoe and the pruner, the drought and the tropical savanna. They just don't leave hope behind.

title: O kouklos
description: When the cousins of a lively man throw a party as a pretence to invite the nieces of a strict captain, he poses as the boys' rich aunt, to help them get married. But, what happens if the girls' guardian takes a fancy to the hunk in drag?

title: O... Çocuklari
description: Turkey is under the yoke of the military regime. Unbelievable events will develop in the axis of the house of the custodian mother, who takes care of the children of prostitutes.

title: 49-o
description: Goundamani, the 'counter king, makes a comeback this time with a lead role dealing with the nuances of local politics

title: O+
description: In the 90's, two successful Dominicans living in Buenos Aires face rejection, prejudice and ignorance for being HIV positive.

title: O Gece
description: The documentary about the attack on Ahmet Kaya in the Magazine Journalists Association Award Ceremony and what happened afterwards.

title: O Jeca Contra o Capeta
description: Jeca has to face a rich farmer woman that wants his love. At the same time, his wife seems to be possessed by the Devil. Made after the huge success of 'The Exorcist', Mazzaropi created his version of the Blockbuster.

title: O Paciente
description: O Paciente

title: O hrysos kai o tenekes
description: A super market owner opposes the affair of his daughter with a new employee at his business.

title: O Eu Quebrado o Encontrou Novamente
description: Sofrendo bullying e forçada a terminar com seu primeiro amor, ela entrou em uma espiral de dor, acabando em um hospital psiquiátrico onde deu à luz uma filha. Cinco anos depois, lutando para sobreviver com sua filha, as pessoas que a atormentaram voltam. Após deixá-la, seu primeiro amor se tornou um advogado renomado. Quando se encontram acidentalmente na rua, será que podem reacender o amor perdido?

title: O Cantor e o Milionário
description: A bohemian and a businessman change bodies, causing confusion with their friends and families.

title: O exypnakias
description: A young man pretends to be an idiot in order to win over the father of the woman he loves.

title: O Herdeiro
description: Após o assassinato de seus pais, Diego se torna dono de uma grande fortuna. Enquanto todos tentam enganá-lo, ele precisará superar todos os anos de bullying que sofreu para administrar seu império e levar à justiça os mentores do crime.

title: O Pão Que o Diabo Amassou
description: A ruthless loan shark doesn't realize the evil that he has done to his own family: his son is waist-deep in resentment, and his daughter- married to an unsuccessful lawyer - ends up prostituting herself.

title: O apostatis
description: An old man meets with a young hippie and they agree that the latter one will go to the old man's home. When he does, he starts having intimate relations with his wife his sister and their maid at the same time.

title: O Chinadaana
description: Ramya, a young girl, loses faith in love after her childhood crush, Rajesh, relocates elsewhere. However, her sister, Divya, and Srinivasa plot to make her fall in love again.

title: O Canada
description: Created in 1939, the National Film Board of Canada has produced and distributed literally thousands of films by and about Canadians, including hundreds of animated shorts. But despite the fact that these innovative cartoons received several Oscar wins and nominations, most were little-seen by Canada's neighbors to the south.

title: O gennitsaros
description: During the turbulent and dangerous years of the Turkish Occupation of Greece, the oppressive Ottomans systematically abducted Christian boys, to raise and educate them according to the strict Muhammadan standards.

title: O termatismos
description: A running guide to becoming your own hero. Three unique marathon runners - a cocky shepherd, a barefoot warrior and a wise old man - redefine sportsmanship in credit crunch Greece, rendering the finish line irrelevant.

title: O zitianos
description: In the village of Nykteremi (Thessalian plain), a few years after it was annexed to Greece, a cunning professional beggar, Jiritokostas, succeeds in exploiting the misery, fears, prejudices and ignorance of the Thessalonians.

title: O hazobabas
description: More than anything in the world, a hard-working and doting father wants to see his boy become a prominent scientist and a well-respected member of the society, regardless of the cost. However, do the father and son share the same dreams?

title: O Coco, A Roda, O Pnêu e O Farol
description: A documentary about the "roda de coco" in Amaro Branco, place where, for more than 100 years, the people maintain the tradition of this contagious rhythm of the Brazilian northeast. The film shows the characters, the tradition and the wealth of this northeastern dance. More than that, it invites you to the middle of the "roda de coco".

title: O Homem Que Desafiou o Diabo
description: After being forced into a marriage and enduring a humiliating work routine in the hands of his father-in-law, Zé Araújo becomes the mythical Ojuara, an unconventional hero devoted to debauchery.

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: In their P-POP era? ANNE CURTIS, KIM CHIU bumuo ng girl group!
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: Miss Q&A, naging 'PISIKALAN'?
description:
Over the moon ang saya sa pagbisita ni “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” pride Carmelle Collado, fresh from her recent Eurovision Asia journey. Napili ang kantang in-interpret ni Carmelle, "Sobra-Sobra," bilang entry ng Pilipinas sa unang Eurovision Song Contest Asia.

At siyempre, kumpleto ang September 1 dahil hindi lang basta sumilip kundi live na live ang Chan-ta ng Pinas, Jose Mari Chan. Nagkatotoo ang 'memes' nang personal niyang dalhin ang Christmas feels sa “It’s Showtime.”

Wish upon a star, mga kandidata, wit at confidence nila ay on full display. Sina Ringo Antonio, Gina Ganda, at Franco Gray ang nagpakitang-gilas sa “It’s Showtime” today.

Ang trip nila, sumabak sa sayawan. May bonus performance pa si Franco, na inilabas ang kanyang action-star moves a la Coco. Pero kung hataw na hataw sila sa dance floor, medyo napaisip naman ang ating queens pagdating sa tanungan sa “Tumpak Ganern.”

Ang Wit Lang, naging exciting dahil sa face-off nina Franco at Ringo. Napunta kay Franco ang tanong na, “Bakit pa tinatawag na rush hour kung hindi naman umaandar ang traffic?” Samantala, napaisip si Ringo kung maninigarilyo pa ba ang kapre kahit may hika ito.

Habang binibilang ang mga araw bago dumating ang Christmas bonus, sa "It's Showtime" muna makilaro. Malay mo, may naghihintay na aguinaldo. Swerte kaya ay dumating nang big para sa mga taga-Lower Bicutan, Taguig.

Kilig ang regalo nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto. Si Darren, hindi makatingin nang diretso sa ka-eksena, kaya tumawag ng 'take two' si Vice Ganda. Hirit naman ni Kim Chiu, baka hindi makatingin kasi may "feelings" na?!

Ginalingan ni massage therapist Roy sa mga challenges kaya siya ang nakakuha ng spot sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P100,000 ang naghihintay. Para sa anak na nasa autism spectrum, pinili niyang lakasan ang loob at sunggaban ang pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

title: Q Pootle 5
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Q Pootle 5! Join Pootle, Oopsy, Eddi, Stella, Ray, Groobie, Bud-D and Planet Dave as they tackle the everyday problems of the final frontier. Creative and resourceful, Pootle and his friends find fun and adventure wherever they go, with stories that will spark children's imaginations everywhere! We are not alone... Isn't that nice to know?

title: QAnon: The Search for Q S1-S2
description: Explore the origins, rise and social impact of QAnon, whose story has been told to the public one outrageous headline at a time. A comprehensive investigation into the who, what, and why of the viral movement.

title: Miss Q&A Jeraldine & Franco
description:
Inabangan ng sangkabaklaan ang harapan ng mga beki na mahusay sa talakan. Mula Lunes hanggang Biyernes sa “It’s Showtime,” sinala ang mga kandidata sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan, at sa araw na 'to, Sabado, nagkaalaman na kung sino sa limang weekly finalists ang best.

Chukchak mode on sina Ivern Doroteo, Ringo Antonio, Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, Franco Gray, at Billy Labitan Yadao. Bago ang talak, sunod-sunod agad ang patutsada ng mga baklang 'di pakakabog sa isa't isa. At sino itong kandidata na tila ba napagtulungan ng mga kasamahan?

Mula lima, apat ang pumaslak sa Wit Lang round. Mga tanong dito, hindi naman kailangan dibdibin, mas okay kung sasakyan ang 'amats' at lalaruin. At ang Top 2 wittiest candidates of them all, sina Billy at Ringo, umabante sa next round na Beklamation.

Umugong ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena! Umugong din ang pag-asa para sa players na mula sa Brgy. Ugong, Pasig City. Sino kaya ang makakatawid hanggang jackpot round, at makakapag-uwi ng POT money na P300,000?

Fresh frm breakup pa si Sharmy nang maki-join sa kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick. Naikuwento rin niya kung bakit sila naghiwalay ni ex. At ang dahilan? Girl best friend! Kaya sina Anne Curtis at ibang hosts ay napaisip, red flag ba ang isang taong committed na pero super close at minsan nag-a-"I love you" kay best?

Umabante sa jackpot round ang mapagmahal na asawa at ama na si Kokey. Eh di isama na 'yan sa Team Loyal a.k.a. ang samahan ng mga takot sa asawa!

title: Miss Q&A Celeb Edition: Comediennes in their TALAK era!
description:
Tumibok ang puso ng Madlang People sa harana nina Wilbert Ross, Earl Agustin, Amiel Sol, at Rob Deniel. Maytoon pang performance from Carl Guevarra at Fitterkarma. Girl power naman ang sigaw nina Angela Ken at Mariah Deborah.

Sa araw na 'to, mga comediennes ang nag-face off sa entablado para sa Miss Q and A Celebrity Edition. They ate and left no crumbs, sa pasabog nilang wit, laugh trip ang outcome!

Mula sa kaharian ng mga engkatada, pumasok sa mundo ng mga tao si Ethel Booba aka Bathalumang Ethelia, at ang masasabi lang niya, "Uwa!" Beep! Beep! Tabi dahil walang preno, walang U-turn at walang atrasan ang pagtalak ni Alora Sasam aka Alora Boulevard Cubao.

Sweet like candy, fierce like a diva naman si Candy Pangilinan aka Candiva Lacrofasia. Fur real ang ganda ni Verna Periwinkle aka Shitsue Ramirez. Bringing her superpower sa pagpaatawa, join din sa chukchakan si Pokwang aka Pokwangderwomom.

Bago ang Wit Lang pasiklaban, ang mga kandidata napagod na agad sa bardagulan. Pero hindi pa rin nagpawindang sa mga playtime na katanungan. Mula sa lima, tatlo ang pumaslak sa Beklamation, sina Powang, Candy, at Ethel.

Sa Beklamation, hinarap nila ang iisang katanungan, "Ano ang kukumpleto sa 'yong pagkababae?" Sagot ni Pokwang, pamilya. Aruga naman ang kay Candy. At for the first time in Miss Q and A history, may isang kandidata na sumagot habang naka-earphones. Only Ethel can pull it off! At ang talak niya, naging buo ang pagkababae niya sa pagdating ng anak na si Michaela.

title: Vice, na-touch sa pamilyang binuo ni Miss Q&A Bong Bong
description:
Si Will Ashley, may bagong paborito? Na-miss daw ng ex-"PBB Collab" housemate ang Madlang People, kaya super happy siyang makabalik with good news and performance featuring his debut single na “Paborito.”

Classic OPM feels naman ang hatid ng isa pang bisita na si Ivy Violan, na thankful sa success ng OPM.

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng tatlong kandidatang nagbabalik para sa Resbakulawan round–sina Bong Bong Tagulao, Adam Lambert, at Manika.

Patunay si Bong Bong na hindi lamang iisa ang mukha ng masaya at mapagmahal na pamilya. Twenty-one years strong na ang pagsasama nila ng partner, at may dalawa na silang anak. Ipinakilala ni Bong Bong ang partner at anak kay Vice Ganda, na na-touch dahil proud na proud sina Bong Bong sa binuong ‘modern family.’

Mula sa nakakaantig na kuwentuhan, balik-talak naman ang mga kandidata nang sumabak sila sa Wit Lang round at bumunot ng playtime questions.

Sina Adam at Manika ang umabante sa Beklamation round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, “Anong sa palagay mo ang naituturo ng pagkatalo na hindi naituturo ng panalo?”

Numero uno ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lalo na sa pagdating ng mga players na nagmula pa sa Concepcion I, Marikina.

Ang nag-emerge na numero uno sa mga challenges at laro ay walang iba kundi si player Isa, na rumaraket sa pamamagitan ng pagttitinda ng samu’t saring kutkutin. For today’s video, ang P350,000 POT money naman ang goal niyang kunin.

title: Vice Ganda PINAUWI muna si Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A candidate, hinalikan ni Jhong
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: NAHULI ANG PAG-IRAP ng Miss Q&A candidate
description:
Enjoy lang sa pasiklaban ang mga kandidatang bitbit ang bandera ng sangkabaklaan.

Graduating student si Lixa Labbuanan, na dream maging flight attendant. Sa intro niya na "walang retoke," si Vice Ganda, nag-react, na para bang tinamaan?! Rapping naman ang talent ni Kim Nunez, pero hindi nagpakabog si Candiate 3, Scarlet Gajol, na rumatsada rin sa eme-emeng rap kaya ang Madlang People hindi matigil sa pag-laugh!

Kung si Scarlet ay magiging rap artist, tatawagin siyang 'Raf Ref Rif Rof Ruf.' Pagdating sa TumPak Ganern, tawanan ay through the roof dahil sa mali-mali niyang sagot! Ang English ng "kuko," sabi niya ay "nipa hut." Sino nga ba ang may kasalanan? Si Scarlet na sumagot, o si Meme Vice na nagtatanong lang naman?

Sa Round 2 na WIT Lang, sina Lixa at Kim ang naglaban! Nabunot ni Lixa ang tanong tungkol sa mararamdaman niya 'pag nakapatay ng lamok na breadwinner. Si Kim naman ay pasasalamat ang binanggit nang matanong kung anong gagawin kapag binigyan siya ng isang ektaryang lupa na nakasako.

Mga mahal nating lolo't lola, bumida at na-experience ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Si Tatay Pabling, pinatunayan ang pagiging Solid Showtimer dahil kabisado niya ang pangalan ng mga hosts! Perfect, walang nakalimutan! Masayahin si tatay, at masaya rin ang buhay kasama si misis, na apat na dekada na niyang iniibig!

Hindi mo naman makakalimutang tumawa sa mga eksena for today's video. Hindi naman siya ang naglaro sa jackpot round, pero si Jackie Gonzaga ang pumaldo sa kilig nang pag-agawan nina Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto. Si Vice Ganda, napag-trip-an na naman nina Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro, ginawang manika 'yan siya!

Si Mommy Jo ang umabante sa jackpot round, kung saan P100,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Ngunit para sigurado, Li-Pot offer na P25,000 ang pinili ni Mommy Jo. May special offer din si Meme, na dodoblehin daw ang P25k kung sakaling masasagot ni Mommy Jo ang POT question.

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

title: Amats malala! EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nagpakilala sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

#ShowtimeMQA2026
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode

description: A quiet suburban neighborhood declares war on a heavy metal music DJ and his radio station, triggering an all-out war between the "metal heads" and the "straights."

description: The first entry of Tsuburaya Productions' "Ultra Series," in which an aviator/amateur sci-fi writer, his plucky assistant, and a young female newspaper reporter investigate strange phenomena, usually involving aliens and giant monsters.

title: Ms. Castro umupo bilang Miss Q&A hurado
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Breaking Muse winner Verna, hurado sa Miss Q&A!
description:
Si Will Ashley, may bagong paborito? Na-miss daw ng ex-"PBB Collab" housemate ang Madlang People, kaya super happy siyang makabalik with good news and performance featuring his debut single na “Paborito.”

Classic OPM feels naman ang hatid ng isa pang bisita na si Ivy Violan, na thankful sa success ng OPM.

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng tatlong kandidatang nagbabalik para sa Resbakulawan round–sina Bong Bong Tagulao, Adam Lambert, at Manika.

Patunay si Bong Bong na hindi lamang iisa ang mukha ng masaya at mapagmahal na pamilya. Twenty-one years strong na ang pagsasama nila ng partner, at may dalawa na silang anak. Ipinakilala ni Bong Bong ang partner at anak kay Vice Ganda, na na-touch dahil proud na proud sina Bong Bong sa binuong ‘modern family.’

Mula sa nakakaantig na kuwentuhan, balik-talak naman ang mga kandidata nang sumabak sila sa Wit Lang round at bumunot ng playtime questions.

Sina Adam at Manika ang umabante sa Beklamation round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, “Anong sa palagay mo ang naituturo ng pagkatalo na hindi naituturo ng panalo?”

Numero uno ang saya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lalo na sa pagdating ng mga players na nagmula pa sa Concepcion I, Marikina.

Ang nag-emerge na numero uno sa mga challenges at laro ay walang iba kundi si player Isa, na rumaraket sa pamamagitan ng pagttitinda ng samu’t saring kutkutin. For today’s video, ang P350,000 POT money naman ang goal niyang kunin.

title: R
description: In Los Angeles in 1965, unfulfilled B-list director Gordon Flemyng (Brad Pollak) receives the screenplay of a lifetime from his old friend Robert Sabaroff (Mark Baker), who is insistent they make a film that promises to entertain like no other. With football legend, turned actor, Jim Brown (J'amore Ward) attached to the picture, it seems the sky's the limit for these two filmmakers. Desperate to finally receive the recognition he's longed for, Gordon struggles to find the balance between passion and stardom. However, when Gordon pushes the MPAA rating guidelines of traditional cinema, he finds himself in a rabbit hole he's unsure he can escape from when his movie ("The Split" 1968) receives the first ever R-rating.

title: R-17
description: A new counselor at an all-girls school in Japan finds that her new workplace is a disaster area: not only are the students suffering through bullying, sexual harrassment, drug addiction and other problems, the teachers are having nervous breakdowns and the administrators don't want to hear a word of it. Number one on her problem list is a vicious sadist who also happens to be the headmaster's daughter. Will she be able to help turn the school around, or will she be crushed and spat out like her predecessors?

title: Ready o/r Rot
description: Guy and Heidi are finally headed for the altar, but pressure from Guy's mother creates so much friction between them that they wonder why they got married in the first place.

title: Sonic and Tails R

title: Malls R Us
description: What do Al Gore, the Tower of Babel, science fiction, gothic cathedrals, artichokes and roller coasters have in common? All come together in Malls R US, a feature documentary with a multiplex of reflections and revelations on one of North America's most popular institutions: the enclosed shopping center. Mixing nostalgia, architectural ambition, pop culture and politics, MALLS R US travels from North America, the mall's origins, to its most impressive newer hosts: Poland, Japan, India and Dubai. We also meet some of the world's most renowned contemporary retail architects and developers who explain how malls are the medium through which the 21st century will rebirth cities, inspire monument building, unite mankind and even help the planet grow green.

title: You're Fired!!
description: An unemployed journalist and a recently fired Bouncer form a detective agency and then proceed to utterly bungle their first case: a bizarre mystery involving a murder of a milkman.

title: We're Not Safe Here
description: After vanishing, a woman returns with a chilling tale. Now, she and her friend are hunted by a dark force that twists fear into reality.

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: Localisé(s)
description: 2 young students are helping their 40-years-old friend to recover the love of his life.

title: [S]comparse
description: On a small, isolated island between Sicily and Africa, a film crew lands to shoot a large-scale feature film. The filmmaker and his entourage settle on the island providing employment to the locals, but disrupting their bucolic daily rhythm. A large group of Africans are brought to the Island from Sicily, to work as background on the film. The job requires that they get into the water and interpret the part of refugees arriving by rickety boat, something most of them have actually experienced.

title: S. O. S. - Spasite nase duse
description: The plot of this film can be viewed from a two different levels. The first is universal and deals with the psychological theme of need for competition in the group, highlighting the need for the victory, which in life usually does not depend on the true virtues of the winner, so the result is usually tragicomic. The story talks about the choice of the most noble work. Selected participants arrive at the guest house on the border between Croatia and Serbia to prepare for the final act of the competition and the jury's decision. Seven competitors have a rather narrow view of the world. Even when the big events, such as ethnic conflicts in this part of the Balkans, the contestants insist to proceed the competition and to choose the hero of heroes, even though the very idea of competition has become anachronistic under the pressure of current events (the anger of the local Serbian population of the newly established Croatian authorities).

title: S Kem Povedeshsya
description: The plot of the story is based on the fate of an intelligent and sensitive woman Marina. She has a cozy apartment inherited from her parents and a husband, a successful banker, to whom she dedicated herself, giving up friends and a career. But one day the man stuns Marina with the news of his desire to divorce. It is difficult for a woman to get used to loneliness. And later we have to look for a common language with Galina, which Marina is forced to temporarily let into her house after she was hit by a car. Women are barely acquainted and completely different, but later Galina will try her best to arrange Marina's personal life. In search of women's happiness, Halyna and Marina will meet worthy and rather strange admirers, face insidious enemies and try to solve their internal problems. Galina's 17-year-old daughter will also live with women, and the girl's first love will confuse everyone and provoke new problems.

description: Black comedy about the routine of a large corporation, producing chocolate bars. The claustrophobic office space and its dwellers are part of a funny and grotesque picture. description: A youth who finds a dinosaur egg accidentally breaks it. Soon after, she begins to have surreal visions of dinosaurs, including the Tyrannosaurus Rex.

title: Een dag in 't jaar
description: Misha, Seb and Yvonne drift away from a New Year's Eve party and start walking not knowing where they are heading. Coping with the loss of their brother, old friend and first love, they delay time: while they experience their continuous walk to last only 24 hours, in fact an entire year passes.

title: Totally T-Boz
description: The show focuses on the 42-year-old single mom as she tries to re-launch her music career after recovering from the life-threatening brain tumor she was diagnosed with in 2006.

title: Dot-t
description: A deadly meteor strike on a planet in the distant galaxies brings destruction and the desperate escape of a young extraterrestrial in a space pod - and is forever separated from her mother and father. On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

title: Alone in the T-Shirt Zone
description: Michael Mikaele is a young man in a catatonic state living in a psychiatric ward where his doctor thinks her sympathies for him justify raping him. It's all part of his mad world, and we see what brought him there. He's an artist from a broken home, working for eight years at a job that he loathes, drawing pictures from sayings on sexually suggestive T-shirts. Mike's unsympathetic boss, Bill, plays bad motivational tapes over the P.A., makes Mike's girlfriend (another employee) handle him during office hours, which is espied by co-worker Joni, and refuses to let Mike have the rest of the day off even though he is clearly ill. He ties together T-shirts out the bathroom window to escape, and befriends a man, Rod, whom, unbeknownst to him, is his girlfriends father. He, however, hallucinates that the cinematographer is walking around the apartment in nothing but a towel. When the two attend a party, where everyone in the film (except his parents, doctor, and nurse) seem to be, things really start to unravel into his present nightmarish state, as well as revealing his constantly disturbed state of mind.

title: U Turn
description: A journalist who intends to write an article on traffic rule breakers gets dragged into a whirlpool of murder cases and deception.

title: Pozoriste u kuci
description: "Theater at Home" was a classic Yugoslavian TV sitcom that ran for five seasons from 1972 till 1984. It was a story about the working-class Petrovic family. Patriarch Rodoljub is a lawyer from the small village of Przogrnci. His wife Olga is an architect and they have a son, Borko. Their maid Tina poses as their relative for tax reasons. The most memorable characters are the old-school mother-in-law Snezana and her friend Vasa S. Tajcic, who has a huge imagination but is disliked by the rest of the family. Other characters include landlord Ceda Mungos, his cheating wife Rajka, Rodoljub's co-worker Taja, and Rodoljub's mother Vuka from Przogrnci.
